gallery.title: File:Radiation Laboratory Steering Committee.jpg
gallery.description:
The Steering Committee of the Radiation Laboratory in February, 1944. Pictured at one of their weekly meetings are, left to right: 
(1) Isidor I. Rabi of Columbia University (Associate Director of the Laboratory and a Nobel Prize winner) 
(2) Ernie C. Pollard of Yale
(3) Tom W. Bonner of the Rice Institute
(4) J. William Hinkley then of the Central Hudson Gas and Electric Co., (6) Ray G. Herb of the University of Wisconsin, (8) Lauriston C. Marshall of the University of California, (9) Louis N. Ridenour of the University of Pennsylvania, (10) Lee A. DuBridge of the University of Rochester (Laboratory Director), (12) John G. Trump of M.I.T. (Assistant Director), (14) D. H. Ewing of Smith College, (15) James L. Lawson of the University of Michigan, (16) F. Wheeler Loomis of the University of Illinois (Associate Director), (13) Britton Chance of the University of Pennsylvania. 
Standing are (5) Jerrold Zacharias then of Hunter College, (7) L. J. Haworth of the University of Illinois, and (11) D. G. Wliite of the Farmer's Cooperative Bank of Berkeley, California, for Herb Gaither. 
Seated, right rear, are (17) Channing Turner, former president of the U. S. Wind Engine and Pump Co. of Batavia, Illinois, and (18) Ivan A. Getting of M.I.T. 

Absent: James R. Killian, Jr., J. Street, L. Turner, and M. White.
